meta.source: Reference board (Midjourney-style dark dashboard UI kit) + DevShop app conventions

color.note: Dark is the primary theme; light mirrors it for screenshots, docs and the light mode toggle. Every text token's note names the grounds it reads on; every fill has an on-* partner.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. The deepest ground; nothing sits below it.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the sidebar and topbar. The default surface most content sits on.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Inputs, table header rows, hover state of quiet rows and list items.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Selected/active fills (active nav item, pressed quiet button, segmented control thumb).

tokens.name: bg-cream
tokens.usage: Inverted feature panel (the light card on the board). Text on it is `on-cream`. Use at most one per view.

tokens.name: on-cream
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bg-cream`.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative; not required to meet 3:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and panel borders. Cards are separated by borders first, shadows second.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that carry meaning: input borders, checkbox and toggle outlines, table header underline. 3:1 on `bg-100` and `bg-200`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg-000`, `bg-100`, `bg-200`, `bg-300`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, table meta, timestamps. On `bg-000` to `bg-300`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, tertiary icons. On `bg-000` to `bg-300` (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink`-filled block (the inverted button, tooltips).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: PRIMARY accent fill: the one primary button per view, active toggle track, progress fill, selected calendar day, ring stroke. Text on it is `on-peach`, never white.

tokens.name: peach-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of a `peach` fill; the hot end of the peach gradient. Text on it is still `on-peach`.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for peach chips, highlighted rows and icon wells. Text on it is `peach-text`.

tokens.name: peach-text
tokens.usage: Peach used as TEXT or an icon: links, positive deltas that are brand-coloured, active tab label. 4.5:1 on `bg-000` to `bg-300` and on `peach-soft`.

tokens.name: on-peach
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `peach` and `peach-strong` fills.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: SECONDARY accent fill: charts (second series), tags for categories, the occasional feature card. Never for the primary action. Text on it is `on-violet`.

tokens.name: violet-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of a `violet` fill; hot end of the violet gradient.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for violet chips and category tags. Text on it is `violet-text`.

tokens.name: violet-text
tokens.usage: Violet used as TEXT or an icon. 4.5:1 on `bg-000` to `bg-300` and on `violet-soft`.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `violet` and `violet-strong` fills (dark ink in the dark theme, white in the light theme).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill: progress that completed, online dots, the positive-delta arrow. Pair with a word or icon; never the only signal.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success chips and banners. Text on it is `success-text`.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success as text or icon on `bg-000` to `bg-300` and `success-soft`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill: quota nearly used, unsaved changes. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning chips and banners. Text on it is `warning-text`.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text or icon on `bg-000` to `bg-300` and `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger fill: destructive buttons, error dots. Pink-red so it never reads as peach. Text on a danger fill is `on-danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error chips, invalid inputs and banners. Text on it is `danger-text`.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and icons on `bg-000` to `bg-300` and `danger-soft`. Also the invalid input border.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational fill: neutral notices, the 'new' dot. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info chips and banners. Text on it is `info-text`.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info as text or icon on `bg-000` to `bg-300` and `info-soft`.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (peach). First series of every chart; the only series on a single-series chart.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (violet).

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (cyan). Chosen to differ from 1 and 2 in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (pink).

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (cream / stone). Use for a baseline or 'other' bucket.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (slate) and the grid/axis colour when a sixth series is needed.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baselines. Hairline; never darker than `line`.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress bars and rings.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring drawn 2px OUTSIDE the control (outline-offset: 2px), so it sits on the surface, never on the fill. 3:1 on `bg-000` to `bg-300` in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: gradient-peach-start
tokens.usage: Start of the signature peach 'sunset' gradient (top-left). Only on hero tiles and the cover; never behind text smaller than 24px.

tokens.name: gradient-peach-end
tokens.usage: End of the peach gradient (bottom-right). Text on the gradient is `on-peach`.

tokens.name: gradient-violet-start
tokens.usage: Start of the violet gradient (top-left).

tokens.name: gradient-violet-end
tokens.usage: End of the violet gradient (bottom-right). Text on it is `on-violet` in the dark theme only; in light, keep text off it.

type.note: Manrope for everything UI (Google Fonts, weights 400-800). JetBrains Mono for code, IDs, hashes and tabular numbers. No third family.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero metric on a full-width stat panel. One per view.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Big number in a StatTile or ProgressRing centre.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page title in the content header.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section title above a group of cards or a table.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a card, dropdown section headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form copy: docs pages, empty states, modal descriptions.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, list items, form values, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in a list, emphasised cell values, button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text under inputs, table meta. Colour `ink-muted`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a metric or a sidebar group label. Colour `ink-muted`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, JSON output, regex patterns, IDs.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code, colour values, keyboard keys, hashes in tables.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Tabular numbers in tables and stat rows. Set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

spacing.note: 4px base. Components use steps 1-6; layout uses 8-16.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; gap between stacked hairline rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline items (buttons in a row, tags). Chip padding-x. Inner padding of icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button padding-x. Gap between a label and its control. Compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between cards in a grid. Padding of list rows and table cells. Sidebar item padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on the default card. Modal padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards and modals. Gap between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page content padding at desktop. Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of the content area under the topbar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between major dashboard regions; empty state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar width and topbar height.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content area; centred beyond it.

radius.note: Rounded, never round: cards and controls share a soft corner; only avatars, dots, toggles and progress rings are circular.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, kbd keys, tiny chips, table cell highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, tags, menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, dropdown panels, toast.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature cards, modals, the sidebar panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero tiles with the peach gradient; image thumbnails in feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, toggle track and thumb, pill badges, progress bars.

shadow.note: Dark theme separates by border and a faint inner top highlight; shadows only lift overlays. Light theme uses soft warm-grey shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Default card. A 1px top highlight in dark, a whisper of shadow in light. Always with a `line` border.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, hover-lifted cards, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-peach
tokens.usage: Hover glow on the primary button and on the active ring in a ProgressRing.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Keep the token colours; drop the opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-hover-fill
tokens.usage: White (dark) or ink (light) at this alpha as the hover wash on quiet rows.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the topbar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, always above modals.
